get_methods.name: get_collection_data
get_methods.description: TEP-62: the next wallet index, the collection metadata and the admin.

get_methods.name: get_collection_settings
get_methods.description: Returns the max wallet index and the public deploy settings.

get_methods.name: get_nft_address_by_index
get_methods.description: TEP-62: address of wallet `walletIndex`, deployed or not.

get_methods.name: get_nft_content
get_methods.description:
Expands `TraitSetContent` into off-chain content
"<commonContent><traitSetIndex>/<walletIndex>.json".
Expands `WalletIndexContent` into "<commonContent><walletIndex>.json".
Both formats ignore the bits and refs after their fields.
Returns other content as is: it must already be TEP-64.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidWorkchain
thrown_errors.description: An address is not in the basechain.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.NotFromAdmin
thrown_errors.description: The sender is not the collection admin.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidWalletIndex
thrown_errors.description: The wallet index of a deploy retry or a content edit is not allocated yet.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.WrongNetwork
thrown_errors.description: The network ID in the collection storage is not the ID of the current network.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.WalletLimitReached
thrown_errors.description: A new wallet index is past the collection's max wallet index.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.TooSmallDeployValue
thrown_errors.description: The value can not pay the deploy price and the storage reserve of the wallet.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.UnknownOperation
thrown_errors.description: The message is not a known operation.
